about_intro: Alvyo is an open platform for planning and sharing hikes in Switzerland.
about_source: Alvyo is free software under the AGPL-3.0. The source code of this version is available here:
about_data: Maps, elevation model (swissALTI3D) and trail network: © swisstopo. Path network for routing, huts and accommodation: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Public transport stops: Federal Office of Transport FOT. Hiking times use the SwitzerlandMobility / Swiss Hiking Trails formula.
about_safety: Hiking times and difficulties are computed estimates. Check weather, conditions and the signposts on site.
about_privacy: We store what your account needs: e-mail address, username, display name, a password hash (argon2id) and your routes, journeys, collections, comments, likes, follows and blocks. Only what you publish, your comments on it, your display name and how many followers you have are public. If you invite someone by e-mail, we store that address for the invitation. Reports, including the reported text, are kept for moderation. For passkeys we store only the public key, for connected accounts the id and e-mail address at the provider. A single cookie keeps you logged in; there is no tracking and no advertising. National map tiles load through our server; the vector base map and fonts are loaded by your browser directly from swisstopo (geo.admin.ch). For elevation profiles our server sends route coordinates to swisstopo, for connections stops and times to opentransportdata.swiss, in both cases without any information about you. Of photos we keep only the pictures themselves: we remove metadata such as camera and location; if the location is along the route, we keep it as a pin on the map. For the Komoot import, your Komoot password goes to Komoot only; we do not store it. Server logs with IP addresses are kept only briefly for troubleshooting and abuse prevention. You can delete your account and all its content at any time under “Account”.

seo_home_title: Plan and share hikes in Switzerland
seo_home_description: Plan hikes on the swisstopo national maps, with official hiking times and the SAC scale. Multi-day journeys, offline maps in the app and public routes to discover.
seo_discover_description: Find public hikes and multi-day journeys in Switzerland on the map, filtered by difficulty and hiking time.
seo_profile_description: Public hikes and multi-day journeys by {name}.
home_feature_plan: Plan routes on the swisstopo national maps, with hiking times from the official formula and the SAC scale.
home_feature_journeys: Multi-day journeys with accommodation and the way there by public transport.
home_feature_app: Navigate with the iPhone app, even without a network, and record your hikes.
home_feature_discover: Discover other people's public routes, build collections and bring in routes from Komoot or GPX files.
home_headline: Walk until the map runs out.
